engine: Argos Translate en-zh 1.9 · 本地机器翻译

p0.original: There is in every society or neighbourhood an ordinary or average rate, both of wages and profit, in every different employment of labour and stock. This rate is naturally regulated, as I shall shew hereafter, partly by the general circumstances of the society, their riches or poverty, their advancing, stationary, or declining condition, and partly by the particular nature of each employment.
p0.zh: 每个社会或邻里都有工资和利润的普通或平均比率,在劳动力和库存的每一种不同就业中都有。 正如我下文所述,这一比率自然受到社会的一般情况、其财富或贫穷、其进步、固定或下降状况以及每项就业的特殊性等的制约。

p1.original: There is likewise in every society or neighbourhood an ordinary or average rate of rent, which is regulated, too, as I shall shew hereafter, partly by the general circumstances of the society or neighbourhood in which the land is situated, and partly by the natural or improved fertility of the land.
p1.zh: 同样,每个社会或邻里都有普通或平均的租金率,这一点也由我下文所描述的来决定,其中一部分是由土地所在社会或邻里的一般情况决定的,另一部分是由土地的自然或改良的肥力决定的。

p2.original: These ordinary or average rates may be called the natural rates of wages, profit and rent, at the time and place in which they commonly prevail.
p2.zh: 这些普通或平均工资率可以称为工资、利润和租金的自然工资率,在通常通行的时间和地点。

p3.original: When the price of any commodity is neither more nor less than what is sufficient to pay the rent of the land, the wages of the labour, and the profits of the stock employed in raising, preparing, and bringing it to market, according to their natural rates, the commodity is then sold for what may be called its natural price.
p3.zh: 当任何商品的价格不大于也不低于足以支付土地租金,劳动工资,以及用于提高,准备,并上市的股票利润时,根据商品的自然价格,商品再按其可称为自然价格的价格出售.

p4.original: The commodity is then sold precisely for what it is worth, or for what it really costs the person who brings it to market; for though, in common language, what is called the prime cost of any commodity does not comprehend the profit of the person who is to sell it again, yet, if he sells it at a price which does not allow him the ordinary rate of profit in his neighbourhood, he is evidently a loser by the trade; since, by employing his stock in some other way, he might have made that profit. His profit, besides, is his revenue, the proper fund of his subsistence. As, while he is preparing and bringing the goods to market, he advances to his workmen their wages, or their subsistence; so he advances to himself, in the same manner, his own subsistence, which is generally suitable to the profit which he may reasonably expect from the sale of his goods. Unless they yield him this profit, therefore, they do not repay him what they may very properly be said to have really cost him.
p4.zh: 然后,商品的销售恰恰是为了它的价值,或者它真正使将商品带入市场的人付出的代价;然而,用共同的语言来说,所谓的任何商品的主要成本并不理解要再次出售商品的人的利润,然而,如果他以不允许他在邻里获得正常利润的价格出售商品,那么他显然就是贸易的失败者;因为,通过以某种其他方式使用他的股票,他可能已经取得了这种利润。 他的利润,除了,是他的收入,他的维持生计的适当资金. 由于他正在准备和将货物运入市场,他向工人预付工资或生活费;因此,他以同样的方式向自己预支了自己的生活费,这一般适合他从货物销售中合理预期得到的利润。 除非他们给他这个利润,否则,他们不偿还他们可能非常恰当地认为他确实付出的代价。

p5.original: Though the price, therefore, which leaves him this profit, is not always the lowest at which a dealer may sometimes sell his goods, it is the lowest at which he is likely to sell them for any considerable time; at least where there is perfect liberty, or where he may change his trade as often as he pleases.
p5.zh: 因此,虽然价格使他有这种利润,但并非总能成为经销商有时出售其货物的最低价格,但他在任何相当长的时间内都有可能出售;至少是在有完全自由的情况下,或者他可以随意频繁地改变其贸易。

p6.original: The actual price at which any commodity is commonly sold, is called its market price. It may either be above, or below, or exactly the same with its natural price.
p6.zh: 任何商品普遍销售的实际价格称为其市场价格。 它可能高于或低于,或与其自然价格完全相同。

p7.original: The market price of every particular commodity is regulated by the proportion between the quantity which is actually brought to market, and the demand of those who are willing to pay the natural price of the commodity, or the whole value of the rent, labour, and profit, which must be paid in order to bring it thither. Such people may be called the effectual demanders, and their demand the effectual demand; since it maybe sufficient to effectuate the bringing of the commodity to market. It is different from the absolute demand. A very poor man may be said, in some sense, to have a demand for a coach and six; he might like to have it; but his demand is not an effectual demand, as the commodity can never be brought to market in order to satisfy it.
p7.zh: 每种特定商品的市场价格,按实际上市的数量与愿意支付商品自然价格,或租金,劳务,利润等全部价值的人的需求的比例调节,必须支付这些价格才能带来锡. 这类人可能被称为有效需求者,他们的需求是有效需求;因为也许足以实现商品进入市场。 这与绝对需求不同。 从某种意义上说,一个非常贫穷的人可以说是需要一个教练和六个教练;他也许想要一个教练;但他的要求并不是一个有效的要求,因为商品永远不能被带入市场以满足.

p8.original: When the quantity of any commodity which is brought to market falls short of the effectual demand, all those who are willing to pay the whole value of the rent, wages, and profit, which must be paid in order to bring it thither, cannot be supplied with the quantity which they want. Rather than want it altogether, some of them will be willing to give more. A competition will immediately begin among them, and the market price will rise more or less above the natural price, according as either the greatness of the deficiency, or the wealth and wanton luxury of the competitors, happen to animate more or less the eagerness of the competition. Among competitors of equal wealth and luxury, the same deficiency will generally occasion a more or less eager competition, according as the acquisition of the commodity happens to be of more or less importance to them. Hence the exorbitant price of the necessaries of life during the blockade of a town, or in a famine.
p8.zh: 当进入市场的任何商品的数量低于实际需求时,所有愿意支付租金、工资和利润的全部价值的人,如果必须支付这些价值,才能将其带回,则不能得到他们想要的数量。 他们中有些人愿意付出更多,而不是完全想要。竞争将立即在它们中间开始,市场价格将或多或少地高于自然价格,因为要么是缺乏的伟大,要么是竞争对手的财富和奢侈,或是或多或少地使竞争的急切性变得活跃起来. 在同等财富和奢侈品的竞争者中,同样的缺陷一般将引起或多或少的渴望性竞争,因为购买商品对他们来说或多或少都很重要。 因此,在封锁一个城镇或发生饥荒期间,生活必需品付出了高昂的代价。

p9.original: When the quantity brought to market exceeds the effectual demand, it cannot be all sold to those who are willing to pay the whole value of the rent, wages, and profit, which must be paid in order to bring it thither. Some part must be sold to those who are willing to pay less, and the low price which they give for it must reduce the price of the whole. The market price will sink more or less below the natural price, according as the greatness of the excess increases more or less the competition of the sellers, or according as it happens to be more or less important to them to get immediately rid of the commodity. The same excess in the importation of perishable, will occasion a much greater competition than in that of durable commodities; in the importation of oranges, for example, than in that of old iron.
p9.zh: 当带入市场的数量超过实际需求时,不能全部卖给愿意支付全部租金,工资,利润的人,这些必须支付,才能带回黄金.一部分必须出售给那些愿意支付更少的人,他们为此付出的低价必须降低整体的价格.市场价格将或多或少低于自然价格,因为超额价格的庞大性或多或少地增加了销售者的竞争,或根据它们是否对立即摆脱商品有重要的意义。 在进口易腐烂品方面,同样的过剩将比耐用商品引起更大的竞争;例如,在进口橙子方面,比旧铁要多得多。

p10.original: When the quantity brought to market is just sufficient to supply the effectual demand, and no more, the market price naturally comes to be either exactly, or as nearly as can be judged of, the same with the natural price. The whole quantity upon hand can be disposed of for this price, and can not be disposed of for more. The competition of the different dealers obliges them all to accept of this price, but does not oblige them to accept of less.
p10.zh: 当投入市场的数量仅仅足以满足有效需求,而不再如此时,市场价格自然会变得与自然价格完全相同,或几乎可以判断为与自然价格相同。手头的全部数量可以按这个价格处理,不能再处理更多.不同的经销商的竞争迫使他们都接受这一价格,但并不迫使他们接受更少的价格。

p11.original: The quantity of every commodity brought to market naturally suits itself to the effectual demand. It is the interest of all those who employ their land, labour, or stock, in bringing any commodity to market, that the quantity never should exceed the effectual demand; and it is the interest of all other people that it never should fall short of that demand.
p11.zh: 进入市场的每一种商品的数量自然适合实际需求。 所有雇用土地、劳动力或股票的人在将任何商品投放市场时,其数量永远不应超过实际需求,而且永远不应低于实际需求,这是所有其他人的利益所在。

p12.original: If at any time it exceeds the effectual demand, some of the component parts of its price must be paid below their natural rate. If it is rent, the interest of the landlords will immediately prompt them to withdraw a part of their land; and if it is wages or profit, the interest of the labourers in the one case, and of their employers in the other, will prompt them to withdraw a part of their labour or stock, from this employment. The quantity brought to market will soon be no more than sufficient to supply the effectual demand. All the different parts of its price will rise to their natural rate, and the whole price to its natural price.
p12.zh: 如果在任何时候超过实际需求,其价格的某些组成部分必须低于其自然利率。 如果租金是房租,房东的利益将立即促使他们收回一部分土地;如果是工资或利润,则在一案中的工人和在另一案中的雇主的利益将促使他们从这种就业中撤出一部分劳动力或库存。投入市场的数量很快将不足以满足实际需求。其物价的所有不同部分都将上升至其自然速率,整个物价则上升至其自然价.

p13.original: If, on the contrary, the quantity brought to market should at any time fall short of the effectual demand, some of the component parts of its price must rise above their natural rate. If it is rent, the interest of all other landlords will naturally prompt them to prepare more land for the raising of this commodity; if it is wages or profit, the interest of all other labourers and dealers will soon prompt them to employ more labour and stock in preparing and bringing it to market. The quantity brought thither will soon be sufficient to supply the effectual demand. All the different parts of its price will soon sink to their natural rate, and the whole price to its natural price.
p13.zh: 相反,如果投向市场的数量在任何时候都应低于实际需求,则其价格的某些组成部分必须高于其自然利率。 如果是租金,所有其他地主的利益自然会促使他们准备更多的土地来提高这种商品;如果是工资或利润,所有其他劳工和经销商的利益很快会促使他们雇用更多的劳工和股票来准备和将其带入市场.带来的硫醚数量很快将足以提供有效需求。其价格的所有不同部分很快会沉没于他们的自然速率,整个价格也会沉没于其自然价格.

p14.original: The natural price, therefore, is, as it were, the central price, to which the prices of all commodities are continually gravitating. Different accidents may sometimes keep them suspended a good deal above it, and sometimes force them down even somewhat below it. But whatever may be the obstacles which hinder them from settling in this centre of repose and continuance, they are constantly tending towards it.
p14.zh: 因此,自然价格是所有商品价格不断引领的中央价格。不同的事故有时会让它们悬浮在它之上,有时甚至会迫使它们倒置在它的下面。 但是,无论可能有哪些障碍阻碍他们在这个安居和继续的中心定居,他们都不断朝这个中心倾斜。

p15.original: The whole quantity of industry annually employed in order to bring any commodity to market, naturally suits itself in this manner to the effectual demand. It naturally aims at bringing always that precise quantity thither which may be sufficient to supply, and no more than supply, that demand.
p15.zh: 每年为将任何商品投放市场而雇用的工业总量,自然符合实际需求。其自然目的是始终提供足够供应、而且仅能供应的准确数量。

p16.original: But, in some employments, the same quantity of industry will, in different years, produce very different quantities of commodities; while, in others, it will produce always the same, or very nearly the same. The same number of labourers in husbandry will, in different years, produce very different quantities of corn, wine, oil, hops, etc. But the same number of spinners or weavers will every year produce the same, or very nearly the same, quantity of linen and woollen cloth. It is only the average produce of the one species of industry which can be suited, in any respect, to the effectual demand; and as its actual produce is frequently much greater, and frequently much less, than its average produce, the quantity of the commodities brought to market will sometimes exceed a good deal, and sometimes fall short a good deal, of the effectual demand. Even though that demand, therefore, should continue always the same, their market price will be liable to great fluctuations, will sometimes fall a good deal below, and sometimes rise a good deal above, their natural price. In the other species of industry, the produce of equal quantities of labour being always the same, or very nearly the same, it can be more exactly suited to the effectual demand. While that demand continues the same, therefore, the market price of the commodities is likely to do so too, and to be either altogether, or as nearly as can be judged of, the same with the natural price. That the price of linen and woollen cloth is liable neither to such frequent, nor to such great variations, as the price of corn, every man's experience will inform him. The price of the one species of commodities varies only with the variations in the demand; that of the other varies not only with the variations in the demand, but with the much greater, and more frequent, variations in the quantity of what is brought to market, in order to supply that demand.
p16.zh: 但是,在一些职业中,同样数量工业在不同年份中生产出非常不同的商品数量;而在另一些行业中,生产量总是一样或几乎一样。畜牧业中同样数量的劳工在不同年份会生产出非常不同的玉米,葡萄酒,油料,跳马等数量. 但同样数量的旋转器或编织器每年都会产生同样或几乎相同的亚麻布和羊毛布的数量. 只有一种工业的平均产品在任何方面都能够适合有效需求;由于实际产品往往比平均产品多得多,而且往往比平均产品少得多,因此,进入市场的商品数量有时会超过实际需求的大宗,有时甚至低于大宗。 因此,尽管这种需求应始终如一,但其市场价格将面临巨大波动,有时会大大低于自然价格,有时会大大高于自然价格。 在其他行业中,相同数量劳动力的产品总是相同的,或者几乎是相同的,它可以更准确地适应实际需求。 因此,虽然这种需求保持不变,但商品的市场价格也可能如此,要么完全如此,要么几乎可以判断与自然价格相同。亚麻布和羊毛布的价格 既不会如此频繁,也不会如此大的变化, 如玉米的价格, 每个人的经验都会告诉他。一种商品的价格仅随着需求的变化而变化;另一种商品的价格不仅随着需求的变化而变化,而且为了供应这种需求而使进入市场的商品的数量发生更大、更频繁的变化。

p17.original: The occasional and temporary fluctuations in the market price of any commodity fall chiefly upon those parts of its price which resolve themselves into wages and profit. That part which resolves itself into rent is less affected by them. A rent certain in money is not in the least affected by them, either in its rate or in its value. A rent which consists either in a certain proportion, or in a certain quantity, of the rude produce, is no doubt affected in its yearly value by all the occasional and temporary fluctuations in the market price of that rude produce; but it is seldom affected by them in its yearly rate. In settling the terms of the lease, the landlord and farmer endeavour, according to their best judgment, to adjust that rate, not to the temporary and occasional, but to the average and ordinary price of the produce.
p17.zh: 任何商品的市场价格偶尔或暂时波动,主要取决于其价格中决定工资和利润的部分。解决租金问题的部分受到租金的影响较小。一定数额的租金不是受租金影响最小的,无论是租金率还是租金价值。租金要么占粗劣产品的一定比例,要么占一定数量,毫无疑问,这种粗劣产品的市场价格偶尔或暂时波动,对租金的年价值产生影响;但这种租金在年利率方面很少受到影响。 在解决租赁条件时,房东和农民根据他们的最佳判断,努力调整这一费率,而不是临时和偶然的,而是调整产品的平均和普通价格。

p18.original: Such fluctuations affect both the value and the rate, either of wages or of profit, according as the market happens to be either overstocked or understocked with commodities or with labour, with work done, or with work to be done. A public mourning raises the price of black cloth ( with which the market is almost always understocked upon such occasions), and augments the profits of the merchants who possess any considerable quantity of it. It has no effect upon the wages of the weavers. The market is understocked with commodities, not with labour, with work done, not with work to be done. It raises the wages of journeymen tailors. The market is here understocked with labour. There is an effectual demand for more labour, for more work to be done, than can be had. It sinks the price of coloured silks and cloths, and thereby reduces the profits of the merchants who have any considerable quantity of them upon hand. It sinks, too, the wages of the workmen employed in preparing such commodities, for which all demand is stopped for six months, perhaps for a twelvemonth. The market is here overstocked both with commodities and with labour.
p18.zh: 这种波动影响到工资或利润的价值和比率,因为市场恰好是用商品或劳力过度储存或不足储存,工作完成,或工作完成。公众的哀悼会提高黑布的价格(在这种场合,市场几乎总是被压低),并增加拥有大量黑布的商人的利润.它对织工的工资没有影响。市场储量不足的是商品,而不是劳动力,工作完成,工作完成.它可以提高旅人裁缝的工资. 这里的市场是劳动力不足的。 人们实际上需要更多的劳动力,需要做更多的工作,这是无法做到的。其使有色丝绸布的价格下沉,从而减少了手头有相当数量的商贩的利润.生产这些商品的工人的工资也因此减少,所有需求都停止了六个月,也许长达12个月。 这里的市场既有商品,也有劳力,都过度囤积。

p19.original: But though the market price of every particular commodity is in this manner continually gravitating, if one may say so, towards the natural price; yet sometimes particular accidents, sometimes natural causes, and sometimes particular regulations of policy, may, in many commodities, keep up the market price, for a long time together, a good deal above the natural price.
p19.zh: 但是,尽管每一种特定商品的市场价格都是以这种方式不断向自然价格倾斜的,如果人们可以这么说的话;但有时是特定的事故,有时是自然原因,有时是特定的政策条例,在许多商品中可能长期维持市场价格,大大高于自然价格。

p20.original: When, by an increase in the effectual demand, the market price of some particular commodity happens to rise a good deal above the natural price, those who employ their stocks in supplying that market, are generally careful to conceal this change. If it was commonly known, their great profit would tempt so many new rivals to employ their stocks in the same way, that, the effectual demand being fully supplied, the market price would soon be reduced to the natural price, and, perhaps, for some time even below it. If the market is at a great distance from the residence of those who supply it, they may sometimes be able to keep the secret for several years together, and may so long enjoy their extraordinary profits without any new rivals. Secrets of this kind, however, it must be acknowledged, can seldom be long kept; and the extraordinary profit can last very little longer than they are kept.
p20.zh: 如果由于实际需求增加,某些特定商品的市场价格恰好比自然价格高,那么那些利用股票供应市场的人一般会小心地掩盖这一变化。 如果众所周知,它们的巨大利润将诱使许多新的竞争者以同样的方式使用其股票,这样,有效的需求得到充分供应,市场价格将很快降低到自然价格,也许在一段时间内甚至低于自然价格。 如果市场与供应者住所相距甚远,他们有时也许可以一起保守几年的秘密,并且可以长久地享受他们的非同寻常的利润,而没有任何新的对手. 然而,必须承认,这种秘密很少可以长期保存;而超乎寻常的利润可能比保留的时间长得多。

p21.original: Secrets in manufactures are capable of being longer kept than secrets in trade. A dyer who has found the means of producing a particular colour with materials which cost only half the price of those commonly made use of, may, with good management, enjoy the advantage of his discovery as long as he lives, and even leave it as a legacy to his posterity. His extraordinary gains arise from the high price which is paid for his private labour. They properly consist in the high wages of that labour. But as they are repeated upon every part of his stock, and as their whole amount bears, upon that account, a regular proportion to it, they are commonly considered as extraordinary profits of stock.
p21.zh: 制造中的秘密可以比贸易中的秘密保存得更长.找到一种特定颜色的制作方法,而这种材料的价格仅为常用材料的一半,只要管理得当,只要他活着,就可能享受到发现的优势,甚至把它留给他的后代。 他的非凡收益来自为他的私人劳动付出的高价。劳动力的工资很高,这是正确的。 但是,由于它们重复在他的股票的每一个部分,而且由于它们的全部数额都与它成比例,因此通常被认为是股票的超寻常利润。

p22.original: Such enhancements of the market price are evidently the effects of particular accidents, of which, however, the operation may sometimes last for many years together.
p22.zh: 市场价格的这种上涨显然是某些事故的影响,但有时这些事故会一起持续多年。

p23.original: Some natural productions require such a singularity of soil and situation, that all the land in a great country, which is fit for producing them, may not be sufficient to supply the effectual demand. The whole quantity brought to market, therefore, may be disposed of to those who are willing to give more than what is sufficient to pay the rent of the land which produced them, together with the wages of the labour and the profits of the stock which were employed in preparing and bringing them to market, according to their natural rates. Such commodities may continue for whole centuries together to be sold at this high price; and that part of it which resolves itself into the rent of land, is in this case the part which is generally paid above its natural rate. The rent of the land which affords such singular and esteemed productions, like the rent of some vineyards in France of a peculiarly happy soil and situation, bears no regular proportion to the rent of other equally fertile and equally well cultivated land in its neighbourhood. The wages of the labour, and the profits of the stock employed in bringing such commodities to market, on the contrary, are seldom out of their natural proportion to those of the other employments of labour and stock in their neighbourhood.
p23.zh: 一些自然生产需要如此独特的土壤和情况,以致一个伟大国家中适合生产的土地可能不足以满足有效需求。 因此,可以将全部投入市场的数量,以及劳动力的工资和在准备和将其带入市场时所雇用的股票的利润,按其自然价格,交给愿意付出超过支付土地租金的那些人。 这种商品可能持续了几百年才以这种高价出售;其中一部分解决了土地的租金问题,在这种情况下,一般是支付高于其自然价格的部分。提供这种独特和受人尊敬的土地的租金,如法国一些葡萄园的租金,其土地和情况特别幸福,与其邻近地区其他同样肥沃和同样良好的耕地的租金没有固定比例。 相反,劳动力的工资以及将这类商品投入市场的股票利润,很少超出其与附近其他劳力和股票就业的自然比例。

p24.original: Such enhancements of the market price are evidently the effect of natural causes, which may hinder the effectual demand from ever being fully supplied, and which may continue, therefore, to operate for ever.
p24.zh: 市场价格的这种上涨显然是自然原因的影响,可能阻碍有效需求永远得到完全供应,因此,这种需求可能继续维持下去。

p25.original: A monopoly granted either to an individual or to a trading company, has the same effect as a secret in trade or manufactures. The monopolists, by keeping the market constantly understocked by never fully supplying the effectual demand, sell their commodities much above the natural price, and raise their emoluments, whether they consist in wages or profit, greatly above their natural rate.
p25.zh: 给予个人或贸易公司的垄断与贸易或制造方面的秘密具有同等效力。垄断者通过使市场不断减少,从不完全供应有效需求,销售商品大大高于自然价格,提高薪酬,无论是工资还是利润,大大高于自然利率。

p26.original: The price of monopoly is upon every occasion the highest which can be got. The natural price, or the price of free competition, on the contrary, is the lowest which can be taken, not upon every occasion indeed, but for any considerable time together. The one is upon every occasion the highest which can be squeezed out of the buyers, or which it is supposed they will consent to give; the other is the lowest which the sellers can commonly afford to take, and at the same time continue their business.
p26.zh: 垄断价格在任何时候都是最高的。 相反,自然价格,或自由竞争价格,不是在任何时候都可以采取的最低价格,而是在相当长的时间内可以一起采取的价格。一种是每次从买家中挤出的最高额,或假定他们同意给予的最高额;另一种是卖方通常能够承受的最低额,同时继续经营。

p27.original: The exclusive privileges of corporations, statutes of apprenticeship, and all those laws which restrain in particular employments, the competition to a smaller number than might otherwise go into them, have the same tendency, though in a less degree. They are a sort of enlarged monopolies, and may frequently, for ages together, and in whole classes of employments, keep up the market price of particular commodities above the natural price, and maintain both the wages of the labour and the profits of the stock employed about them somewhat above their natural rate.
p27.zh: 公司的专属特权、学徒章程以及所有那些特别限制就业的法律,其竞争数量比本来可能涉及的要少,但也有同样的趋势,尽管程度较低。 它们是一种扩大的垄断,而且往往会把年龄加在一起,在各种就业类别中,使特定商品的市场价格高于自然价格,并维持劳动力的工资和为这些商品服务的股票利润略高于其自然价格。

p28.original: Such enhancements of the market price may last as long as the regulations of policy which give occasion to them.
p28.zh: 市场价格的这种提高可能要持续到政策条例允许它们出现之时。

p29.original: The market price of any particular commodity, though it may continue long above, can seldom continue long below, its natural price. Whatever part of it was paid below the natural rate, the persons whose interest it affected would immediately feel the loss, and would immediately withdraw either so much land or no much labour, or so much stock, from being employed about it, that the quantity brought to market would soon be no more than sufficient to supply the effectual demand. Its market price, therefore, would soon rise to the natural price; this at least would be the case where there was perfect liberty.
p29.zh: 任何特定商品的市场价格,尽管可能长期高于市场价格,但很少能够长期低于其自然价格。 无论支付部分低于自然利率,其利益受到影响的人都会立即感受到损失,并立即撤出如此多的土地或没有多少劳动力或如此多的库存,从而很快投入市场的数量将不足以满足实际需求。 因此,其市场价格将很快上升到自然价格;至少在有完全自由的情况下。

p30.original: The same statutes of apprenticeship and other corporation laws, indeed, which, when a manufacture is in prosperity, enable the workman to raise his wages a good deal above their natural rate, sometimes oblige him, when it decays, to let them down a good deal below it. As in the one case they exclude many people from his employment, so in the other they exclude him from many employments. The effect of such regulations, however, is not near so durable in sinking the workman's wages below, as in raising them above their natural rate. Their operation in the one way may endure for many centuries, but in the other it can last no longer than the lives of some of the workmen who were bred to the business in the time of its prosperity. When they are gone, the number of those who are afterwards educated to the trade will naturally suit itself to the effectual demand. The policy must be as violent as that of Indostan or ancient Egypt (where every man was bound by a principle of religion to follow the occupation of his father, and was supposed to commit the most horrid sacrilege if he changed it for another), which can in any particular employment, and for several generations together, sink either the wages of labour or the profits of stock below their natural rate.
p30.zh: 同样的学徒法和其他公司法,事实上,当制造业繁荣时,这些法规使工人能够提高工资,使其大大高于其自然利率,有时,当其衰败时,他不得不使这些法规大大低于自然利率。在一个案例中,他们将许多人排除在他的工作之外,因此在另一个案例中,他们将他排除在许多工作之外。 然而,这些条例的影响在降低工人的工资低于其工资水平方面,以及在提高工人的自然工资水平方面,并不那么持久。 他们以一种方式运作可能持续许多世纪,但在另一种情况下,这种运作只能持续到一些工人的生命,他们是在繁荣时期培养出来的。离开后,接受贸易教育的人数自然会适应实际需求。这项政策必须像印度斯坦或古埃及那样暴力(在那里,每个人都受到宗教原则的约束,要追随父亲的占领,如果换换另一个,就应该犯下最可怕的亵渎行为),在任何特定就业中,以及数代人一起使劳动工资或股票利润低于其自然利率。

p31.original: This is all that I think necessary to be observed at present concerning the deviations, whether occasional or permanent, of the market price of commodities from the natural price.
p31.zh: 目前我认为,对于初级商品市场价格偏离自然价格的情况,无论是偶然的还是永久性的,都有必要予以注意。

p32.original: The natural price itself varies with the natural rate of each of its component parts, of wages, profit, and rent; and in every society this rate varies according to their circumstances, according to their riches or poverty, their advancing, stationary, or declining condition. I shall, in the four following chapters, endeavour to explain, as fully and distinctly as I can, the causes of those different variations.
p32.zh: 自然价格本身随工资、利润和租金每个组成部分的自然率而变化;在每个社会,这种价格因具体情况、财富或贫穷、进步、固定或下降而变化。 在以下四章中,我将努力尽可能全面和明确地解释这些不同变化的原因。

p33.original: First, I shall endeavour to explain what are the circumstances which naturally determine the rate of wages, and in what manner those circumstances are affected by the riches or poverty, by the advancing, stationary, or declining state of the society.
p33.zh: 首先,我将努力解释决定工资比率的自然情况,以及这些情况如何受到财富或贫穷、社会的进步、静止或衰退的影响。

p34.original: Secondly, I shall endeavour to shew what are the circumstances which naturally determine the rate of profit; and in what manner, too, those circumstances are affected by the like variations in the state of the society.
p34.zh: 第二,我将努力说明自然决定利润率的是什么情况;这些情况也以什么方式受到社会状况类似变化的影响。

p35.original: Though pecuniary wages and profit are very different in the different employments of labour and stock; yet a certain proportion seems commonly to take place between both the pecuniary wages in all the different employments of labour, and the pecuniary profits in all the different employments of stock. This proportion, it will appear hereafter, depends partly upon the nature of the different employments, and partly upon the different laws and policy of the society in which they are carried on. But though in many respects dependent upon the laws and policy, this proportion seems to be little affected by the riches or poverty of that society, by its advancing, stationary, or declining condition, but to remain the same, or very nearly the same, in all those different states. I shall, in the third place, endeavour to explain all the different circumstances which regulate this proportion.
p35.zh: 虽然在不同的劳动力和库存就业中,金钱工资和利润大不相同;但是,在所有不同的劳动力就业中,金钱工资和所有不同的库存就业中金钱利润之间似乎通常都有一定比例。 这一比例,在下文看来,部分取决于不同就业的性质,部分取决于从事这些就业的社会的不同法律和政策。 但是,尽管在许多方面依赖于法律和政策,但这个比例似乎没有受到这个社会的财富或贫困、其进步、固定或下降状况的影响,而是在所有这些不同的州保持不变或几乎相同。 第三,我将努力解释规定这个比例的所有不同情况。

p36.original: In the fourth and last place, I shall endeavour to shew what are the circumstances which regulate the rent of land, and which either raise or lower the real price of all the different substances which it produces.
p36.zh: 第四,也是最后一点,我将努力说明管理土地租金、提高或降低土地生产的所有不同物质的实际价格的情况。
